full_judgment: 2(a). In the recent survey operation, the land has been recorded in the name of the Petitioner in plot No.3I28, under the Khatian No.527, in Mouza Brahmanbaria. Subsequently, a proceeding was started, being No.2734 of 1961 under Section 49 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 for revision at the instance of the local Tahsildar on the grounds that the disputed land is a part of Taha-Bazar and khas land of the Ex-rent receiver: The petitioner contested the proceeding by submitting his written objections and stating, amongst other that the land in question was not the. Khas land of the Ex. land receiver. The Assistant Settlement Officer has allowed the objections of the Petitioner by his order dated 21.10.1961. But the Opposite Party preferred a Revisional application on the grounds that the disputed plot was within the ambit and periphery of the Ananda Bazar, whereupon the settlement officer directed a local enquiry by the Charge officer. Comilla and the charge officer submitted a report stating that the bulk area of Gagat Bazar would not be taken to be within the periphery of Fiat except two small plots. Viz 3725 and 3543, which might he kept under acquisition and the rest may by recorded in the names of the possessors:. The plot numbers 3170, 3167, 3157, 3156, 3145, 3144, 3232, 3134, 3139, 3136 and 3130 might be taken within the periphery of flat and recorded in the name of the Collector and the remaining plots might he recorded in the names of the .possessors and the Compensation Assessment Roll he corrected accordingly.
